017package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.mcp.v20260728;
018
019import java.util.*;
020
021/**
022 * Resolves the set of scopes required to invoke a specific MCP operation (SEP-2350 per-operation step-up enforcement).
023 *
024 * <p>
025 * The {@code 2026-07-28} resource server enforces per-operation scopes at the POST-parse dispatch point (where the
026 * JSON-RPC method is known); a resolver returning a non-empty set that the caller's granted scopes do not satisfy causes
027 * a {@code 403 insufficient_scope} step-up challenge naming the required scopes.
028 *
029 * <p>
030 * The default resolver is a <b>static per-operation map</b> populated via
031 * {@link McpResourceServerConfig#addOperationScope(String, String, String...)} &mdash; sufficient for 10.0 per the
032 * READY-312f settled premise.  This interface is the seam a future <em>dynamic</em> resolver (e.g. one inspecting
033 * {@link McpOperationContext#params() params}) could plug into via
034 * {@link McpResourceServerConfig#setOperationScopeResolver(McpOperationScopeResolver)}; that dynamic capability is
035 * deliberately not built for 10.0.
036 *
037 * @since 10.0.0
038 */
039@FunctionalInterface
040public interface McpOperationScopeResolver {
041
042   /**
043    * Returns the scopes required to invoke the given operation.
044    *
045    * @param ctx The resolved operation (method, name, raw JSON-RPC params).  Never {@code null}.
046    * @return The required scopes.  An empty or {@code null} return means "no per-operation requirement beyond the
047    *    endpoint-wide baseline".
048    */
049   Set<String> requiredScopesFor(McpOperationContext ctx);
050}
